name: ASK Automotive Ltd
title: ASK Automotive Ltd - 544022 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Q4 EBITDA margin 12.1% hit by alloy pass-through lag (80 bps, Rs 5 Cr loss); management guides mid-teens FY27 growth and ~Rs 400 Cr capex, with Karoli utilisation only 65%.

utilisation.quote: In the Karoli plant, the capacities utilization is still 65%

capex.quote: FY27 we'll be spending about Rs. 400 Cr.

triggers.label: Aluminium pass-through lag in Q4
triggers.quote: some of the aluminium rise could not be passed on, in the aftermarket

triggers.label: Bangalore plant utilisation 90%
triggers.quote: Bangalore we have reached 90% capacity utilization

triggers.label: Negative working capital from receivables
triggers.quote: So, there is increase in receivables share and I think that is the only reason.

triggers.label: Mid-teens FY27 growth reaffirmed
triggers.quote: We are confident that will continue to grow around mid-teens in FY27.

guidance.quote: We are confident that will continue to grow around mid-teens in FY27.
FY27 we'll be spending about Rs. 400 Cr.
FY27 we are expecting revenue of around Rs. 90 - Rs. 100 Cr
This year we are very confident of growing at 20%, provided the geopolitical situation remains reasonable

red_flags.label: Q4 margin hit from unpassed aluminium; Rs 5 Cr loss
red_flags.quote: There was a conscious loss by us of Rs. 5 Cr because every day we cannot increase the prices

red_flags.label: Negative working capital from receivables build
red_flags.quote: So, there is increase in receivables share and I think that is the only reason.

evasions.quote: I think that's a very hypothetical question and I'm sorry I can't answer on that.

evasions.topic: Last deficient monsoon impact on sales
evasions.quote: Sir, we don't clearly remember. Sorry, I don't want to give a wrong data to you
We don't see the margin pressure on that side.
